Name: Ellie's Ideal Greenhouse
Author: ellibehr
Description:
[b][u][size=5]Features[/size][/u]:[/b]
[size=3]This is a greenhouse expansion mod with 5 map sizes (4 of which have 2 versions to pick from) for you to enjoy depending on your playstyle/installed mods![/size]

[b][u][size=5]Map Types[/size][/u]:[/b]
[list]
[*][u][size=4][b]Modest[/b][/size][/u]: [size=3]Can fit 4 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 192 farmable tiles. Also has room for 8 trees along the sides.[/size]
[*][u][size=4][b]Large[/b][/size][/u]: [size=3]Can fit 12 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 576 farmable tiles. Also has room for 16 trees along the sides (either 2 of each from the base game, or 8 from base game and 8 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]).[/size]
[*][u][size=4][b]Large Rows[/b][/size][/u]: [size=3]Can fit 8 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 384 farmable tiles, plus a section meant for trellised crops that has room for 4 Iridium Line Sprinklers for a total of 96 farmable tiles. Also has room for 8 trees along the sides.[/size]
[*][size=4][u][b]Expanded[/b][/u]:[/size] [size=3]Includes 2 rooms, one for crops and one for trees. The crop room can fit 12 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 576 farmable tiles. The tree room has space for 16 trees (either 2 of each from the base game, or 8 from base game and 8 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]) as well as space for decorating.[/size]
[*][size=4][u][b]Expanded Rows[/b][/u]:[/size] [size=3]I[/size][size=3]ncludes 2 rooms, one for crops and one for trees. The crop room can fit [/size][size=3]8 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 384 farmable tiles, plus a section meant for trellised crops that has room for 6 Iridium Line Sprinklers for a total of 144 farmable tiles. The tree room has space for 12 trees, with 4 other tree spaces in the crop room for a total of 16 trees [/size](either 2 of each from the base game, or 8 from base game and 8 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]). The tree room also includes space for decorating.
[*][u][size=4][b]Spacious[/b][/size][/u]:[size=3] Includes 2 rooms, one for crops and one for trees. The crop room c[/size][size=3]an fit 12 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 576 farmable tiles. The tree room has space for 41 trees (8 from base game, 27 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]﻿, and 6 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]﻿) as well as space for decorating.[/size]
[*][u][size=4][b]Spacious Rows[/b][/size][/u]: [size=3]Includes 2 rooms, one for crops and one for trees. The crop room can fit 8 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 384 farmable tiles, plus a section meant for trellised crops that has room for 8 Iridium Line Sprinklers for a total of 192 farmable tiles. The tree room has space for 36 trees, with 5 other tree spaces in the crop room for a total of 41 trees (8 from base game, 27 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]﻿, and 6 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]﻿). The tree room also includes space for decorating.[/size]
[*][u][size=4][b]Enormous[/b][/size][/u]: [size=3]Includes 2 rooms, one for crops and one for trees. The crop room can fit 16 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 768 farmable tiles. The tree room has space for 49 trees (8 from base game, 8 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], 27 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]﻿, and 6 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]﻿) as well as space for decorating.[/size]
[*][size=4][u][b]Enormous Rows[/b][/u]:[/size] [size=3]Includes 2 rooms, one for crops and one for trees. The crop room can fit 8 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 384 farmable tiles, plus a section meant for trellised crops that has room for 8 Iridium Line Sprinklers for a total of 192 farmable tiles. The tree room has space for 44 trees, with 5 other tree spaces in the crop room for a total of 49 trees (8 from base game, 8 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], 27 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]﻿, and 6 from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]﻿). The tree room also includes space for decorating.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]This is my very first mod - if you notice any issues please leave a comment and I'll try to get it sorted out ASAP.[/size]

[b][color=#ff0000][size=5]NOTE ABOUT v1.5:[/size][/color][/b][size=3] [/size][color=#f4f4f4][size=3][u][b]All of the maps have been adjusted[/b][/u], even very minimally. If you aren't wanting to use one of the new map layouts I highly recommend using v1.4.2 of the mod so it doesn't break your greenhouse![/size][/color]

[u][b][size=5]How to Install:[/size]
[/b][/u][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]DO NOT USE VORTEX TO INSTALL[/size][/color][/b]
[list=1][b][size=3][u][/u][/size][/b][*][size=3][b][/b]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[size=3][b][/b][/size][*][size=3][b][/b]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip/extract the[color=#e69138] [b]﻿[CP] Ellie's Ideal Greenhouse[/b][/color] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b]:[/size]
This mod alters the "greenhouse.tmx" file so it is [b][u]not[/u][/b] compatible with any mods that also change that file.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][size=4]﻿Stardew Valley Expanded[/size][/url]﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]If you are using IF2R you will need to set the "Disable_IF2R_Greenhouse" config option to [b]true [/b](default is false).[/size]
[*][size=3]If you are using Grandpa's Farm you will need to set the "LargerGreenhouse" config option to [b]false [/b](default is false).[/size]
[/list][size=5]
[u][b]Recommended Mods[/b][/u]:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]: the easiest way to change your map style (as well as config options for your other mods!)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23895]Line Sprinklers Redux (1.6 Compatible)[/url]: adds line sprinklers which work best with the "rows" version of the greenhouse maps![/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿: for use with both versions of the Spacious and Enormous maps﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]﻿: for use with both versions of the Expanded and Enormous maps﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]﻿: for use with both versions of the Expanded and Enormous maps﻿.[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][color=#ff0000][size=6]WARNING!!![/size]
[/color][/u][/b][size=3]This mod is best used with an empty greenhouse. If you currently have crops planted in your greenhouse I recommend clearing it out before adding this mod to your game or else you risk losing crops/gold (they will be shifted, and depending on where they were, might no longer be accessible).



[/size][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]PLEASE DO NOT DM ME REGARDING THIS MOD. [/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]If you found a bug, make a bug report and include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]error log[/url]. If you have a request, please post a comment with details. Thank you. [url=https://emojipedia.org/purple-heart]💜[/url][/size][/color][/b]
